question: What inscription must be placed within the six-cornered interior of the diagram?
premises: The action prescribed is writing within the six-cornered interior.
The kāma-seed is the element to be written.
The target's name joined with the objective must accompany it.
inference: One should write the kāma-seed together with the target's name joined to the ritual objective inside the six-cornered interior.
uncertainties: Whether kāmaṃ refers specifically to the bīja syllable or a broader mantra form is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: Inside the six-cornered area, one should write the kāma-seed along with the name of the target, joined with the intended objective.
